row: | childhood_schedule | Childhood vaccine schedule | The infant and childhood schedule as a whole: how many shots, at what ages, combination shots, delayed or alternative schedules, comparisons with other countries' schedules, ACIP/CDC changes to the schedule, well-child visits as vaccination occasions. An ACIP vote on one vaccine takes that vaccine's subtopic; ACIP membership and procedure take `vaccines.development_approval`. | CDC schedule; 72 shots; from seventy down to eleven; spacing out shots; alternative schedule; Dr. Bob schedule; Denmark's schedule; the UK vaccine schedule |

| covid_vaccines | COVID-19 vaccines | COVID-19 vaccines and boosters of any platform: efficacy, side effects, recommendations, who should get them. A side effect takes this label plus the condition's subtopic (myocarditis: `cardiovascular.heart_disease`); add `vaccines.safety_injury` when vaccine injury itself is the subject (the vaccine-injured, injury reporting, compensation), and `vaccines.development_approval` when trials, EUA or approval as a process are discussed. | mRNA vaccine; Pfizer; Moderna; booster; J&J shot; Novavax; the vax; vaxxed and unvaxxed; fully vaccinated; clot shot; the jab (not the boxing punch) |

| safety_injury | Vaccine safety, injury & surveillance | Vaccine injury and adverse events in general as a subject, including people described as vaccine-injured, and the systems that monitor or compensate them. A specific vaccine's injuries also take that vaccine's subtopic; one named side effect of one vaccine takes that vaccine's and the condition's subtopics without this label. | adverse events; vaccine injury; the vaccine-injured; VAERS; Vaccine Safety Datalink; VICP; vaccine court; 1986 Act; liability shield; vaccine package insert |

| development_approval | Vaccine development, trials, platforms & approval | How vaccines are developed, tested and approved: trial design, placebo controls, emergency use authorization as a process, ACIP and FDA advisory committees as bodies (membership, procedure), manufacturers' role, and the mRNA platform as such (research funding, state mRNA bans, mRNA vaccines for other diseases). Vaccine-maker economics go to `health_system.pharma_industry`. | placebo-controlled trial; saline placebo; EUA; Operation Warp Speed; ACIP committee; VRBPAC; mRNA technology; BARDA mRNA contracts cancelled; mRNA cancer vaccine |

| uptake_hesitancy | Uptake, hesitancy, access & vaccine decisions | Vaccination rates, hesitancy, trust in vaccines, the anti-vaccine movement, how parents decide, pediatricians dismissing unvaccinated families, informed consent for vaccines, and access and coverage (Vaccines for Children, insurer and pharmacy rules). An outbreak blamed on falling vaccination takes the disease's subtopic plus this label. | vaccination rates falling; vaccine hesitant; anti-vax movement; unvaccinated kids; pediatrician fired us; Vaccines for Children program |

| origins | Origins of SARS-CoV-2 | Where the virus came from: lab leak, natural spillover, wet market, gain-of-function research on coronaviruses, EcoHealth, the Wuhan Institute of Virology. Calling it the "China virus" without discussing where it came from is not this label; gain-of-function research and bioweapons outside SARS-CoV-2 go to `infectious.emerging_outbreaks`. | lab leak; Wuhan lab; gain of function; EcoHealth Alliance; wet market; Proximal Origin; Daszak |

| masks_distancing | Masks, distancing & isolation | Non-pharmaceutical measures applied to individuals: masks, social distancing, and quarantine or isolation of an exposed or infected person. "The quarantine" meaning the 2020 stay-at-home period goes to `covid.lockdowns_closures`. | mask mandates; N95; cloth masks; six feet; quarantine after exposure; isolation period |

| lockdowns_closures | Lockdowns & school closures | Lockdowns, stay-at-home orders (including "the quarantine" as a period), business and school closures, and their health, social and economic costs. Quarantine or isolation of an exposed or infected person goes to `covid.masks_distancing`. | lockdown; during quarantine; school closures; learning loss; shutdowns; the lockdowns caused depression |

| influenza_avian | Influenza & avian flu | Seasonal influenza and avian or pandemic flu as diseases, including someone's own bout of the flu and historical flu pandemics. "Stomach flu" goes to `infectious.foodborne`; "cold and flu season" with no specific illness goes to `infectious.respiratory_common`. | flu season; had the flu; H5N1; bird flu; avian flu in cattle; Tamiflu; 1918 Spanish flu |

| emerging_outbreaks | Emerging outbreaks, pandemic threats & biosecurity | Outbreaks of emerging, rare or exotic pathogens and pandemic threats other than flu, and biosecurity: bioweapons, biolabs, and gain-of-function or dual-use pathogen research outside the SARS-CoV-2 origins debate (which goes to `covid.origins`). | Ebola; Marburg; hantavirus; mpox; Disease X; New World screwworm; Nipah; bioweapons; biolabs; gain-of-function research |

| foodborne | Foodborne illness & stomach bugs | Infections and poisonings from food, and acute infectious gastroenteritis whatever its source. | E. coli; Salmonella; Listeria; food poisoning; botulism; raw-milk pathogens; Cyclospora; norovirus; stomach bug; stomach flu |

| antibiotics_resistance | Antibiotics & resistance | Antibiotic use and overuse in people, side effects (microbiome damage also takes `gut.microbiome`), resistance, superbugs. Antibiotics in livestock and "raised without antibiotics" meat claims go to `food.organic_gmo`; add this label only when resistance or human exposure is discussed. | antibiotics; overprescribing; C. diff; MRSA; superbugs; antibiotic resistance |

| other_infections | Other infections | A named infection not listed above, including historical epidemics. Sepsis and septic shock go to `acute_care.emergency_critical_care`, plus the source infection's subtopic when it is named; yeast infections go to `womens.gynecological_conditions`; latent or reactivated infections blamed for chronic illness go to `chronic_complex.persistent_infections`. | tuberculosis; hepatitis B or C infection; fungal infection; staph infection; UTI; cellulitis; meningitis; mono; plague; smallpox; cholera |

| microbiome | Gut microbiome | The gut microbiome: composition, diversity, the gut-brain axis, damage to it, microbiome testing and fecal transplant. Vaginal, oral and skin microbiomes go to `womens.gynecological_conditions`, `oral.oral_hygiene` and `skin_beauty.skincare`; vagus-nerve devices go to `stress.nervous_system_regulation`. | gut bacteria; microbiome diversity; gut-brain axis; the gut is the second brain; dysbiosis; stool test; GI-MAP; fecal transplant |

| digestive_symptoms | Digestion, digestive symptoms & functional disorders | Everyday digestive complaints, functional gut disorders, food sensitivities, and digestion as a process (stomach acid, enzymes, motility, bowel regularity). Reflux drugs also take `medications.other_drugs`, digestive-enzyme or betaine supplements `supplements.other_compounds`; H. pylori goes to `gut.gi_disease` and bile to `gut.liver_gallbladder`. | bloating; constipation; reflux; GERD; heartburn; IBS; SIBO; food sensitivities; lactose intolerance; low stomach acid; how many times a day we need to poop; gas |

| gi_disease | Diagnosed GI disease | Structural, infectious or inflammatory gastrointestinal disease and its treatment, including H. pylori, appendicitis and hemorrhoids; a biologic for Crohn's or colitis also takes `medications.other_drugs`. Celiac, Crohn's or colitis also take `immune.autoimmune` only when discussed as autoimmune. GI cancers go to `cancer`, stomach bugs to `infectious.foodborne`. | Crohn's; ulcerative colitis; celiac disease; diverticulitis; ulcers; H. pylori; appendicitis; hemorrhoids; gastroparesis (non-GLP-1) |

| candida_histamine | Candida & histamine intolerance | Candida or yeast overgrowth, and histamine intolerance from food (DAO, high-histamine foods), as explanations for symptoms. Histamine reactions attributed to mast cells go to `chronic_complex.mcas_eds`, antihistamines for allergy to `immune.allergies`; candida in a parasite-cleanse ad also takes `detox.parasite_cleanses`. | candida overgrowth; yeast overgrowth; histamine intolerance; DAO enzyme; high-histamine foods; histamine bucket |

| liver_gallbladder | Liver, gallbladder & pancreas | Liver, gallbladder and pancreas health other than fatty liver and cleanses, including bile and gallbladder removal. Pancreatitis or gallbladder events as a GLP-1 side effect go to `glp1.side_effects` unless discussed in their own right. | liver disease; cirrhosis; gallstones; gallbladder removal; bile flow; ox bile; pancreatitis; liver enzymes |

| immune_function | Immune function, fever & "boosting immunity" | The immune system in general and attempts to strengthen it, fever as an immune response and whether to treat it, and the lymphatic system outside a named detox method (lymphatic drainage goes to `detox.binders_drainage`). A fever reported only as a symptom of a named illness takes that illness's subtopic. | immune system; boost immunity; immune support; weak immune system; T cells; NK cells; fever is the body's defense; lymphatic system |

| inflammation | Inflammation as an explanation | Inflammation invoked as a cause of disease or ageing, or as a property of foods, products and lifestyles, and markers of it. Local inflammation of an injured or diseased tissue (a swollen knee, an inflamed tendon) goes to that injury's or condition's subtopic. | chronic inflammation; systemic inflammation; inflammatory foods; anti-inflammatory diet; CRP; inflammaging; neuroinflammation; reduces inflammation |

definition: Chronic, hard-to-diagnose or contested multi-symptom illnesses, persistent infections offered as their cause, and the patient communities around them. Long COVID goes to `covid.long_covid`; acute infections go to `infectious`.

row: | chronic_lyme | Chronic Lyme & co-infections | Lyme disease as a persistent or relapsing illness, and its co-infections. Persistence may be implied by relapse or long-term or repeated treatment; Lyme told only as an acute infection goes to `infectious.vector_borne`, other persistent infections to `chronic_complex.persistent_infections`. | chronic Lyme; Bartonella; Babesia; long-term antibiotics for Lyme; post-treatment Lyme; spirochetes that keep coming back |

| me_cfs | ME/CFS & chronic fatigue | Myalgic encephalomyelitis / chronic fatigue syndrome, and chronic fatigue presented as a condition or diagnosis. "Chronic fatigue" named only as a symptom or in an ad testimonial goes to `wellness.energy_fatigue`; post-COVID cases also take `covid.long_covid`. | ME/CFS; chronic fatigue syndrome; post-exertional malaise; diagnosed with chronic fatigue |

| mcas_eds | MCAS, histamine reactions & Ehlers-Danlos | Mast cell activation syndrome and histamine reactions attributed to mast cells, hypermobility disorders and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome. Dietary histamine intolerance stays in `gut.candida_histamine`; "hypermobile" meaning joint range in training is not this label. | MCAS; mast cells; mast cell stabilizers; histamine and hormones; EDS; hypermobility spectrum |

| mold_illness | Mold illness & CIRS | Mold or biotoxin illness as a diagnosis or as the explanation for symptoms. When the same passage also covers finding or remediating mold in a building, add `environment.indoor_air_mold`; mold allergy goes to `immune.allergies`. | mold toxicity; CIRS; mycotoxin illness; I had a severe mold exposure; Shoemaker protocol; mold detox |

| patient_experience | Living with chronic illness | The experience of living with chronic, undiagnosed or multiple illnesses and of seeking care for them: medical gaslighting, dismissal, diagnostic odysseys, patient communities. "Chronic illness" as a general category or trend goes to `wellness.chronic_disease_trends`. | doctors dismissed me; gaslit by the doctors; it's all in your head; ten years to a diagnosis; spoonie |

| persistent_infections | Persistent, reactivated & "hidden" infections | Latent, persistent or reactivated infections invoked to explain chronic symptoms or disease: Epstein-Barr and other herpesvirus reactivation, mycoplasma, and "stealth" or "hidden" infections. The condition explained also takes its own subtopic (EBV and Hashimoto's: `endocrine.thyroid` and `immune.autoimmune`); chronic Lyme goes to `chronic_complex.chronic_lyme`, long COVID to `covid.long_covid`, an acute infection (mono, a shingles outbreak) to its `infectious` subtopic. The claim that such infections underlie most chronic disease is `narrative:stealth_infections_root`. | Epstein-Barr reactivation; EBV and Hashimoto's; herpes viruses reactivated; stealth infections; bugs and hidden infections; mycoplasma; EBV and MS |

| exposure_syndromes | Exposure & implant syndromes | Named multi-symptom illnesses attributed to an exposure, weapon or implant whose cause or recognition is disputed, other than mold and Lyme: Havana syndrome, Gulf War illness, breast implant illness, multiple chemical sensitivity, electromagnetic hypersensitivity, Morgellons. Also code the exposure's or injury's subtopic when its harm is discussed (`neuro.concussion_tbi`, `skin_beauty.cosmetic_procedures`, `radiation_light.wireless_emf`). | Havana syndrome; directed-energy attack; Gulf War illness; burn-pit illness; breast implant illness; explant surgery; multiple chemical sensitivity; EMF sensitivity; Morgellons |

| inheritance | Inheritance, genetic risk & gene expression | What is inherited and how; genetic risk variants (APOE4, BRCA as a risk gene); genes versus lifestyle; epigenetics as gene expression changed by lifestyle or exposures, and epigenetic inheritance. Epigenetic clocks go to `longevity.biological_age`. | family history; runs in the family; hereditary; recessive; APOE4; "genes load the gun"; bad genetics; turning genes on and off; epigenetics |

| genetic_testing | Genetic testing | Genetic and genomic testing, consumer or clinical, embryo screening, and DNA-based health or nutrition reports. An MTHFR variant discussed as a gene or test takes this label; advice to take methylated vitamins because of it takes `supplements.b_vitamins_methylation` (both when both). | 23andMe health report; carrier screening; whole-genome sequencing; polygenic embryo screening; MTHFR test; nutrigenomics |

| gene_therapy | Gene editing & gene therapy | Altering genes to treat or enhance. Calling mRNA vaccines "gene therapy" takes `vaccines.covid_vaccines` (and `narrative:mrna_alters_dna`), not this label, unless gene therapy as a technology is itself discussed. | CRISPR; gene therapy; gene editing; designer babies; follistatin gene therapy; gene therapy for sickle cell |

| fluoride_products | Fluoride & fluoride-free dental products | Fluoride toothpaste, varnish, drops and tablets and other fluoride treatments, and their alternatives. | fluoride toothpaste; hydroxyapatite; fluoride varnish; fluoride drops; fluoride-free toothpaste |

| dental_procedures | Dental procedures, materials & dentistry | Dental work and dental materials, orthodontics and aligners, cosmetic dentistry, jaw problems and teeth grinding, and holistic or biological dentistry as a practice. Tongue-tie release takes this label plus `pregnancy.infant_feeding` when about latch and feeding, or `sleep.apnea_breathing` when about the airway. | root canal; amalgam fillings; mercury fillings; cavitations; holistic dentist; dental implants; braces; clear aligners; veneers; teeth whitening; TMJ; bruxism; night guard; wisdom teeth; tongue-tie release |

| oral_hygiene | Oral hygiene & gum health | Cavities, gum disease, the oral microbiome, oral health as a driver of disease elsewhere in the body, and hygiene practices. | gum disease; cavities; oil pulling; mouthwash and nitric oxide; tongue scraping; oral microbiome; P. gingivalis; bad breath; oral health is linked to heart disease |

| vision | Vision & eye health | Eyes and sight, eye disease and eye-care products. Screens or blue light blamed for eye harm also take `radiation_light.artificial_light`. | myopia; glasses; reading glasses; contacts; LASIK; cataracts; glaucoma; macular degeneration; dry eye; eye drops; eye strain; sunglasses |

| hearing | Hearing, ears & balance | Hearing, ears, and balance or vestibular problems. Motion and seasickness go to `acute_care.poisoning_environmental_injury`. | hearing loss; tinnitus; hearing aids; cochlear implant; ear infections; vertigo; Meniere's disease; inner ear; vestibular system |

| smell_taste_ent | Smell, taste, nose & throat | Smell, taste and ear-nose-throat structures. Loss of smell or taste from COVID also takes `covid.illness_severity`; sinus infections go to `infectious.respiratory_common`. | anosmia; loss of taste and smell; sinus problems; post-nasal drip; deviated septum; tonsils; nasal polyps |
